description:
Doran Estates are delighted to present No. 32 Windmill Avenue to the market, a well-positioned two-bedroom terraced home set in a quiet cul-de-sac and benefiting from a south-east facing rear garden.
Upon entering, the property opens into a welcoming entrance hall with useful under-stairs storage. To the front of the home is a comfortable living room featuring an open fireplace, creating a pleasant focal point to the room.
To the rear, the kitchen and dining area provides a practical space for everyday living and dining, with double doors opening directly onto the rear garden, allowing for easy access to the outdoor space.
Upstairs, there are two generous double bedrooms, with the main bedroom benefiting from convenient built-in storage. The modern family bathroom is fully tiled and fitted with a bath and electric shower attachment.
Externally, the property benefits from a good-sized rear garden, while the front provides off-street parking, adding to the home's convenience.
The location is particularly well served by a range of local amenities. Sundrive Shopping Centre and Ashleaf Shopping Centre are both nearby, offering a selection of shops, cafés and bars. There is also a choice of primary and secondary schools in the surrounding area. For leisure and recreation, William Pearse Park and Swan Leisure Pool are within easy reach.
The property also benefits from excellent transport links, with regular bus services providing convenient access to Dublin City Centre, while the M50 is easily accessible, connecting with the wider national road network.
No. 32 Windmill Avenue offers well-proportioned accommodation, useful outdoor space and a convenient location within easy reach of a range of amenities and transport links.
Early viewing is highly recommended.
